note: The last of the generated approvals. Applied with --only-generic, so any engine already carrying a real manufacturer approval is left alone. Exact codes throughout rather than family patterns, because several of these makes share short codes. More diesels recorded as petrol turn up here: Toyota's H-family in the Land Cruiser, Mazda's Ford- and PSA-sourced units, Renault Trucks' Sofim fours, and Kubota's engines in the Aixam microcars. Codes that could not be identified confidently are deliberately left out rather than guessed at.

engines.source: Toyota's H-family 3.6 and 4.0 six-cylinder diesels in the Land Cruiser 40/60 series, recorded as petrol. Same conventional 15W-40 the Toyota table gives the 1HZ.
1VD-FTV 4.5 V8 turbo-diesel, Land Cruiser 200 and 70. Large sump; the capacity is a family figure rather than a manual one.
Toyota Dynamic Force and the 2AR hybrid family - Camry, RAV4, Corolla. Specified 0W-16 with 0W-20 permitted; a heavier grade is withheld deliberately.
Toyota's remaining older petrols - the F-family sixes in the Land Cruiser, 22RE and 12R/5R fours, and the 2JZ-GTE and VZ V6. Conventional grade suited to hot climates.

The diesels Mazda bought in and the catalogue recorded as petrol: PSA's DV4/DV6 as Y404/Y406 in the Mazda 2 MZ-CD, Ford's 1.4 Duratorq as F6JA/F6JB, Isuzu's 4EE1-T in the 121, and Nissan's MD25 in the pickups.

Mazda's petrol range not covered by the main table - the 13B-MSP Renesis rotary, the KJ-ZEM 2.3 Miller, the CA/CAY 3.7 and CYC4 3.5 V6, and the Ford-shared small fours in the Mazda 2 and 121. API SL/SM with no ACEA requirement.
Maserati's V6 and V8 range (AM 574/578/585, M 138/139/145/156, F160AM). Maserati's own fill is a 5W-40 full synthetic; the capacity is a family figure for a large V8 rather than a manual one.
Honda's small petrols and IMA hybrids - Jazz, Insight, CR-Z, City. Specified 0W-20, so no heavier alternative is offered.
Honda's C-series V6 in the NSX and Legend, and the JNC1 3.5 in the Pilot. Larger sump than the fours.

The Sofim 8140 fours in the Mascott and Messenger - the same family Iveco fits to the Daily - plus the DXi and the ZD3 2.5 dCi. All recorded as petrol. Commercial-duty 15W-40, which also suits Tunisian temperatures.

Kubota Z402 and Z482 and the Lombardini LGW523 in the Aixam microcars. Very small industrial diesels; the capacity is a family estimate, and the change interval is short because these run at near-constant load.

Morgan fits other makers' engines: Ford's AODA 2.0 and MEBA 3.0 V6, and BMW's M62 and N62 V8. A 5W-40 full synthetic covers the range; the BMW V8s would normally take a BMW Longlife oil, which is not asserted here without a source.
Hyundai's 11-12.7 litre heavy truck diesels in the HD and Xcient. Heavy-duty grade and a very large sump; the capacity is a class figure, not a manual one.
Hyundai's 3.0 V6 CRDi in the ix55 / Veracruz. Particulate filter fitted.
Hyundai and Kia petrol codes the family table did not reach - Gamma G4FG and G4LD, Theta G4KE/G4KH, Nu G4NG. Same figures those families take elsewhere here.
